Figure 7: Additional qualitative results on the ImgEdit benchmark. Our methods (Qwen-Edit-ATR and Nano Banana-ATR) demonstrate consistent improvements across various tasks, achieving performance comparable to Nano Banana Pro model.

Figure 3: Qualitative editing results on the ImgEdit benchmark. Compared to direct editing baselines, our ATR framework demonstrates superior performance in fine-grained target isolation, precise spatial grounding, and attribute editing while preserving background consistency.

Figure 4: Qualitative editing results on the PICA benchmark. Our method effectively bypasses failure modes such as spatial translation errors and target disappearance, achieving accurate relocation and pixel-level structural decoupling.

Figure 2: Overview of our framework. Each edit query is first profiled by its target, constraints, and scope, and then routed to a suitable reformulation strategy. A MLLM-based planner performs route-conditioned agentic execution with intermediate states and verification to obtain the final edited image.
